item.title: Reqnivo 0.0.7
item.description:
Reqnivo beta for macOS. This draft is created automatically; review the notes and test the downloaded app before publishing.
- Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 14 or later. - Ad-hoc signed; not notarized by Apple. First launch on another Mac and runtime compatibility with macOS 14 require separate verification. - Assets include the app ZIP, companion mitmproxy 12.2.3 source/rebuild ZIP, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Extract both ZIPs into separate directories. - Swift build/tests, engine integration tests, source checksums, and extracted package verification must pass before this draft is created. These checks do not establish that every runtime/device scenario works or that all dependencies are vulnerability-free. - See `docs/ENGINE_SOURCE.md`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, and `docs/PUBLIC_RELEASE_REVIEW.md` in the tagged source for license notices, rebuild instructions, and remaining distribution review limits.
- LAN access uses **Approve Devices on Mac**. No proxy username/password is required. Unapproved connections are blocked, IP approvals last for one capture, and Revoke disconnects existing traffic.
Changes generated by GitHub follow below.
## What's Changed * Implement update management features with Sparkle integration by @PoiNaPoi in https://github.com/PoiNaPoi/Reqnivo/pull/5 * ci: cache SwiftPM dependencies and retry package resolution by @PoiNaPoi in https://github.com/PoiNaPoi/Reqnivo/pull/6
## New Contributors * @PoiNaPoi made their first contribution in https://github.com/PoiNaPoi/Reqnivo/pull/5
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PoiNaPoi/Reqnivo/compare/v0.0.6...v0.0.7
